name: Guangdong Lifestrong Pharmacy Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Lifestrong Pharmacy Co., Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company primarily involved in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of various medical products. Its extensive product range includes different dosage forms such as tablets, pills, injections, mixtures, and granules. The company's therapeutic areas of focus encompass respiratory conditions, pediatric care, gynecology, urinary tract health, and nutritional and general healthcare solutions. This enterprise was established in 1951 and operates out of Shantou, China.
